character.description: Restores HP of allies, bouncing between <@ba.kw>3</> allies. Healing reduced by 25% per bounce.
character.itemUsage: Special consultant Mon3tr, choosing to walk the same road as Rhodes Island.
character.itemDesc: We're all very familiar with this name, but we'll have to get to know her from scratch.

levels.description:

<@ba.rem>When skill ends or lethal damage is taken, Mon3tr returns to her original position</>
